name: Discord
layout_summary: Far-left strip: server icons (Discord logo at very top for DMs). Second column: channels or Direct Messages list, with user profile/mic/headphones bar at bottom-left. Center: active chat history and 'Message @name / #channel' input box at the bottom.
avoid_traps: NEVER confuse a 1-on-1 Direct Message user with a Group DM! In the left sidebar, a Group DM shows '2 Members' / '3 Members' underneath the name and a solid-colored two-person group icon — NEVER click a row that says 'Members' when asked to message a single person. In Quick Switcher (ctrl+k), 1-on-1 users appear at the TOP with their grey lowercase username handle right next to their display name (e.g. 'Ob  the_ob'), while Group DMs appear at the bottom with solid-colored two-person icons and NO username handle.

MANDATORY '@ ' CHECK BEFORE SENDING: In a real 1-on-1 DM, the bottom chat input box placeholder ALWAYS says 'Message @<Name>' (WITH an '@' symbol, e.g. 'Message @Ob'). If the bottom input box says 'Message <Name>' WITHOUT '@' (e.g. 'Message Ob') or the header/sidebar shows 'N Members', you are inside a Group Chat — DO NOT send the message! Immediately press ctrl+k, type the name with press_enter=false, and select the top 1-on-1 user row that has a grey username handle.

In Quick Switcher (ctrl+k), NEVER pass press_enter=true inside type_text (React takes ~400ms to filter, so immediate Enter jumps to the wrong server!). Instead, call type_text(contact_name, press_enter=false) without '@'. On the next step, once the filtered dropdown is visible on screen with the 1-on-1 user ('<Name> <username_handle>') highlighted at the very top, either call press_key('enter') or smart_click the top user row with the username handle.

Do NOT scroll down the Direct Messages sidebar looking for a contact (scrolling down lands in old multi-member Group DMs). If the contact's 1-on-1 DM (no 'Members' subtitle) is not immediately visible at the top of the sidebar, press ctrl+k to use Quick Switcher.
Top header contact/channel name is display-only — do NOT click it once inside chat.

quick_switcher.primary: press_key('ctrl+k') -> type_text(target_name, press_enter=false) -> smart_click('matching row in Quick Switcher results')
quick_switcher.visual_fallback: smart_click('Find or start a conversation button at top of left sidebar')
quick_switcher.verify: Quick Switcher modal filters results and clicking the matching entry opens the target DM/channel

open_dm.primary: If the 1-on-1 user (NO 'N Members' subtitle) is visible at the top of the Direct Messages sidebar, smart_click('<name> in Direct Messages sidebar'). Otherwise: press_key('ctrl+k') -> type_text(contact_name, press_enter=false) -> verify top highlighted result shows '<Name> <username>' (1-on-1 user, NOT a two-person group icon at the bottom) -> press_key('enter') or smart_click('the top <name> user row with username handle in Quick Switcher results')
open_dm.visual_fallback: smart_click('Find or start a conversation button at top of left sidebar') -> type_text(contact_name, press_enter=false) -> press_key('enter')
open_dm.verify: Bottom chat input placeholder MUST say 'Message @<Name>' (with '@', NOT 'Message <Name>' without '@' which is a group chat)

send_message.primary: smart_type('Message input box at bottom of chat', message_text, submit=true)
send_message.verify: Message appears at the bottom of the chat history

toggle_mute.visual_fallback: smart_click('Mute microphone icon at bottom-left next to username')

toggle_deafen.visual_fallback: smart_click('Deafen headphones icon at bottom-left next to microphone')

search_in_channel.verify: Top-right search bar is focused with channel/DM filter

mark_read.verify: Unread indicators in the current channel are cleared
